sources.name: blue-a
sources.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: whole-building transparent source sprites for a tall mobile-game city background. Image1 is the EXACT SHAPE, SCALE AND PLACEMENT edit target. Image2 is STYLE ONLY, never its camera, building proportions or composition.
Primary request: Repaint ONLY the existing solid building regions of Image1 into the approved sunlit miniature architecture style. Preserve exact canvas aspect/framing, original full vertical extent, widths, roof outlines, alpha gaps, positions and distinct object count. This source will be used WHOLE for each building, no horizontal image stitching. Six extremely slender separate blue glass towers, one per existing slot. Keep all six including the very thin far-left strip, their individual heights, antennas and stepped roof outlines. Add fine regular blue-gray window rows and subtle ivory/brass roof trims INSIDE the original widths. The sixth/rightmost column is a plain uninterrupted flat-topped building body, no cap or base.
Style: calm distant miniature architecture, pale ivory and warm-gray ceramic/stone, muted cool blue-gray glass, tiny restrained brass details, soft dimensional bevel shading within existing regions. Flat front elevation with perfectly straight vertical piers and horizontal floor lines; subtle existing side planes only. Every facade has ONE consistent uninterrupted window grid from its own roof to its bottom: same columns, same spacing, no redesign at any height. Quiet low-to-medium contrast, desaturated, no coral focal accents. All building interiors/windows are opaque, genuine alpha only OUTSIDE the building silhouettes. Keep original extremely slender proportions; do not widen a tower to fill the canvas, shorten it, recenter it or add padding. Remove stray cyan/white matte fringe outside the shapes. No sky, fog, ground, landscape, trees, people, UI, lettering, border, glow or watermark. Same tall output aspect and pixel framing as Image1; preserve at least2064px visible height for parts that reach near both canvas ends. Do not introduce any seam, middle rooftop, bulge, cutout hole or disconnected ledge.
